name: Peter
personality: Gentle, timid archer with eyesight good enough to see stars by day.
story: Raised like a brother to Cai in the Dagdan Empire, he joins automatically on Cai's route. On other routes he is recruited through renown, support level 3, and a quest that includes giving him a Phantom Ginji. Further story role not documented.

personalSkill.name: Steady Aim
personalSkill.effect: Rng+1 when attacking with a bow combat art. Lv 20: Correct for Drift (Hit+10 if hit >= 90%). Lv 35: Correct for Drift+ (Hit+20 if hit >= 75%).

tierNotes: KeenGamer: B tier. Pocket Tactics: A tier.

why: Joins Cai's army automatically, so there's no Support or Renown to chase.

build.notes: Hunter in Ch 5, Archer in Ch 6 until Crescendo is mastered, Charioteer at Rider D around Ch 7. Charioteer is a Specialty class, so he never waits on Renown 8, and its growths step up at Lv 35 and 45. Part II Ch 2 to 3: Sniper for Marksmanship (Hit +15 with bows), which Deadeye needs, then back to Charioteer for good.

guide.summary: Steady Aim adds 1 range to bow arts, so Longbow Deadeye reaches 3 to 6. Charioteer never needs an Advanced exam and its growths step up at Lv 35 and 45 (Dex 95, Def 80 on a Ferghanan Horse), so he stays in it all game.
guide.playstyle: Kill fliers and finish wounded foes from 2 to 6 tiles, then Charge lines of enemies. Chariot Armor means no dodging: decide where he ends each turn by who can reach him.
keys: Master Crescendo in Archer before Charioteer: Hit +3 per kill offsets Deadeye's Hit -30.
Train Rider D from Ch 5 at Arena Mounted Training; Charioteer needs it.
Barter the Longbow at Vandahl (Ginji x10 + Cadam x5) and make it his refine project.
Ride a Ferghanan Horse if you can reach Sunfall Path, otherwise a Wild Horse.
Carry a Mini Bow so he can counter at range 1.
Part II Ch 2 to 3: a Sniper stint for Marksmanship, then back to Charioteer for Ch 4.
watch: Charioteer can't dodge: no Avo gear.

Weight: Longbow 13 + Archer's Ring 3 = 16 in Parts I and II: Longbow turns cost his doubles. Part III Da Mina Bow +2 6 + Silver Shield 4 = 10, Longbow +2 13 + 4 = 17, both against Bld + 4 (Giant's Ring); shield off first if x2 slips.
No local source says which horse spots Cai can reach in Part I.

Inventory: Part II 4 core (Longbow, Mini Bow, Archer's Ring, Concoction) plus up to 2 bow swaps; the Longbow must come for Dagda's shield (Ch 5). Part III 5 core (Da Mina Bow +2, Longbow +2, Silver Shield, Giant's Ring, Elixir); Mini or Horsekiller Bow in the open slot.

guide.alt: Bow Adept (Sky Hunter) only if you want an infantry bow; it grows Str 40 against Charioteer's 65. No Part III Master detour: every level outside Charioteer at Lv 45+ skips its biggest growth step. Warrior's Practiced Art (the Hard video's Deadeye fix) needs Axe, Sword and Gauntlet B; Sniper only needs Bow B.

routeNotes.note: Charioteer doubles the mount's growth bonus: on a Ferghanan Horse he grows Def 60 and Str 50 (base Charioteer: Def 40, Str 40). Its Canto lets him shoot and pull back, and Paired Fierce Arts adds Atk on art attacks, which suits Deadeye and Steady Aim. A Wild Horse gives Paired Run and Spd 50, Res 35 instead.
If Cindered Road Cave is out of reach, barter the Conflagrant Gem at Vandahl: Melara x20 + Usamos x10. Plant those on top of the 30 the Ch 8 quest needs.
Centurio's Ch 4 mentoring tutorial gives the Archer's Ring in his kit; keep it on through Part I.
